grammar: Word order: subject, object, verb. With one participant: subject, verb.
A separate word after the noun phrase, marking the instrument, the thing used (“with a spear”).
A separate word after the noun phrase, marking a companion, someone doing it alongside (“with the queen”).
On the verb when the subject is plural.
